scope: Independent adversarial data audit (DA19) of two current dossiers: RSG, LH. 14 load-bearing facts checked (7/7 by ticker), selected per instructions for the claims most likely to break a thesis or a kill criterion if wrong: latest-quarter revenue/GAAP net income/diluted EPS with correct period labels, guidance figures verified verbatim against the cited release, consolidated vs segment figures, debt/leverage on the correct basis and date, litigation/regulatory items, and thesis/kill-criterion-1 consistency. Special attention paid to the four known error patterns named in the task: (1) latest-quarter figures actually being a prior-year or different-quarter column -- tested explicitly for both tickers' quarterly results tables; (2) guidance figures verified to appear verbatim in the cited release; (3) consolidated vs segment figures -- tested for RSG (multi-segment waste company) and LH (Diagnostics vs Biopharma segments); (4) debt on the wrong basis/date -- tested for both. v4/outputs/dossier_precheck.json (RSG: empty array; LH: 8 citation/guidance-unquoted/entity-scope flags, none numeric) and v4/outputs/xbrl_crosstie.json (RSG and LH both: empty flags array) were read in full for both tickers; no numeric crosstie flags existed for either ticker this pass. Method: primary sources only -- SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings-release exhibits, 10-Q/10-K full-text filings, and data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts structured data -- fetched directly with User-Agent 'PersonalEquityResearch research-admin@personal-research.org' at <=2 requests/second and cached locally under C:\Users\user\eqv4\cache\DA19\. Both dossiers were read to their end (no appended Correction sections found on either). Each ticker's one-line thesis and first kill criterion were checked for consistency with the underlying filings.

facts.claim: Thesis/kill-criterion-1 consistency: verdict rests on genuine pricing power sustaining margin expansion; kill criterion 1 (organic related-business revenue growth <2% for two consecutive quarters) has not been triggered -- total-business organic growth (total revenue growth net of the ~1.1pp M&A contribution) was 1.5% (Q1'26: 2.6%-1.1%) and 3.5% (Q2'26: 4.6%-1.1%), both above the 2% floor
facts.source: RSG Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 earnings releases, 8-K Ex-99.1, accessions 0001060391-26-000210 and 0001060391-26-000273
facts.source_value: Q1'26: "Total revenue growth of 2.6 percent includes 2.8 percent organic growth from our recycling and waste business, 1.3 percent organic decline from our environmental solutions business, and 1.1 percent growth from acquisitions." Q2'26: "Total revenue growth of 4.6 percent includes 3.7 percent organic growth from our recycling and waste business, 0.2 percent decline from our environmental solutions business, and 1.1 percent growth from acquisitions." (2.6-1.1=1.5; 4.6-1.1=3.5, matching the dossier's stated 1.5%/3.5% total-business-organic derivation exactly.)
facts.note: The dossier's own '1.5%/3.5% total-business organic' figure is correctly derived from the primary source and the kill criterion is confirmed not triggered. However, the parenthetical '+5.2%/+4.4% related-business growth in Q1/Q26' figures immediately preceding it in the same sentence could not be traced to any verbatim line in either cited release -- the only related-business-revenue growth-component figures found in the primary sources are core price 6.8%/6.4%, average yield 4.1%/4.0%, and volume -1.0%/-1.9% (Q1/Q2'26 respectively), none of which combine to 5.2% or 4.4%. This does not affect the kill-criterion conclusion (not triggered) but the specific 5.2%/4.4% figures are unverifiable against the cited sources and should be re-sourced or removed.

facts.claim: Results table row labelled "2Q'25" reports revenue $3,563.5m, operating income $396.6m, GAAP diluted EPS $3.12 (footnoted "9mo cum., not isolated"), and adjusted EPS $4.35
facts.source: SEC XBRL companyfacts, CIK0000920148 (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax/Revenues, OperatingIncomeLoss, EarningsPerShareDiluted tags); cross-checked to Labcorp Q3 2025 10-Q, accession 0000920148-25-000096, and Q2 2025 10-Q, accession 0000920148-25-000081
facts.source_value: True Q2 2025 (2025-04-01->2025-06-30, per the Q2'25 10-Q): revenue $3,527,300,000; op. income $394,500,000; diluted EPS $2.84 -- this is what the 2Q'26 release itself uses as the correct prior-year comparator ('$3.64 vs. $2.84... $4.99 vs. $4.35'), and is absent from the dossier's '2Q'25' row entirely. True Q3 2025 (2025-07-01->2025-09-30, per the Q3'25 10-Q): revenue $3,563,500,000; op. income $396,600,000; diluted EPS $3.12 (isolated quarterly figure, NOT a 9-month cumulative number) -- this is exactly the data the dossier's table places in the row labelled '2Q'25'.
facts.note: Wrong-quarter mislabeling, exactly the error pattern the task asked to test explicitly: the dossier's '2Q'25' row's revenue/op.income/EPS ($3,563.5m/$396.6m/$3.12) are the true, isolated Q3 2025 figures, not Q2 2025. The true Q2 2025 figures ($3,527.3m/$394.5m/$2.84) are missing from the table -- though they are, inconsistently, correctly used elsewhere in the dossier's own prose (§3, §4 narrative: '$3.64→$2.84... +28.5%'). Compounding the error, the footnote calling the $3.12 EPS figure '9mo cum., not isolated' is itself incorrect -- $3.12 is the true isolated Q3'25 quarterly EPS; the actual 9-month-cumulative EPS through Q3'25 is $8.48 (shown, correctly, in the dossier's adjacent '3Q'25' row). The adjusted EPS $4.35 in the same '2Q'25' row is, separately, the correct true-Q2'25 comparator (matching the 2Q'26 release's own YoY quote) -- meaning the row mixes data from two different quarters under one label. This does not change the headline 2Q'26 YoY growth narrative (independently verified correct above) but the table row and its footnote should be corrected before reuse: relabel the $3,563.5m/$396.6m/$3.12 data as '3Q'25 (isolated)', add the true Q2'25 row ($3,527.3m/$394.5m/$2.84), and fix the mislabeled 9mo-cumulative footnote.
